name_error_minlength: The name must be at least {length} characters long.
name_error_maxlength: The name must be at most {length} characters long.
login_admin_introduction: First, create an admin user. You will be able to create more users at a later time.
login_admin_credentials_info: Keep your credentials safe! There is no way to recover the administrator credentials.
category_label_targetbalance: Set a Target Balance for this Category
category_not_archivable_balance: There are still {#sum/} left in this category. To archive it, the remaining amount must be {#required/}.
category_not_archivable_pending_transact: There are still pending transactions in this category. To archive it, all transactions must be validated.
category_archive_info: Hide categories you no longer need to keep your budget overview tidy. Archived categories can be restored at any time.
category_delete_info: Permanently remove a category you created by mistake or never used. Deletion is only possible while the category holds no money and no transaction references it.
category_not_deletable_balance: There are still {#sum/} left in this category. To delete it, the remaining amount must be {#required/}.
category_not_deletable_transactions: {count} transactions still reference this category — recategorize or remove them first.
category_delete_confirm_description: "{name}" will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.
category_stats_sparkline_label: Monthly spend over the last 12 months
category_archive_description: Here you can find all your archived categories. You can restore them at any time to show them again in your budget overview and assign budgets to them.
category_archive_empty: Archived categories will show up here.
category_table_empty_description: Categories are the envelopes you assign money to. Create one to plan your spending.
new_budget_description: A budget plan includes accounts, categories, and transactions. Create different budget plans to organize these elements separately. For example, you could create one budget plan for your personal finances and another one for your business finances.
new_account_description: An account is basically a representation of your actual account. Create one account per bank account, credit card, etc. Each transaction will be assigned an account later on.
account_placeholder_name: What should your account be called?
account_not_archivable_balance: There is still a balance of {#sum/} in this account. To archive it, the balance must be {#required/}.
account_not_archivable_pending_transacti: There are still pending transactions in this account. To archive it, all transactions must be validated.
account_archive_info: Hide accounts you no longer use to keep your account list tidy. Archived accounts keep their history and can be restored at any time.
account_delete_info: Permanently remove an account you created by mistake or never used. Deletion is only possible while the account has no transactions.
account_not_deletable_transactions: {count} transactions still reference this account — remove them first.
account_delete_confirm_description: "{name}" will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.
account_archive_description: Here you can find all your archived accounts. You can restore them at any time to show them again in your account list.
account_archived_notice_description: Its history is kept but no new transactions can be added. Restore it to use the account again.
account_archive_empty: Archived accounts will show up here.
account_dropdown_empty_hint: No accounts yet — add one below.
unassigned_breakdown_prose_positive: Money counts from the month it arrives; what later months need is already deducted.
unassigned_breakdown_prose_negative_posi: Through this month, more was allocated than came in.
unassigned_breakdown_prose_negative_rese: By {month}, more is allocated than is covered by then.
tutorial_card_description: Two steps and your budget is ready.
tutorial_card_footer_prefix: Then you can record your transactions in
new_category_description: Categories are the different areas where you spend your money, such as shopping, rent, leisure, etc. Create categories to keep track of your spending.
transactions_pagination_page_size_label: How many transactions should be displayed per page?
transactions_empty_description: Spending and income you record for this account will show up here. Income is simply a transaction without a category — it becomes money you can assign to your categories.
transactions_filtered_empty_description: Adjust or clear your filters to see your transactions.
transfer_amount_hint: A negative amount leaves this account, a positive amount arrives.
transaction_filter_category_description: Only show transactions of selected categories.
invitation_dialog_description: {inviterName} wants to give you access to the budget plan {#b}{budgetName}{/b}.
invitation_decline_confirm_description: The invitation will be removed. To join this budget later, you will need a new invitation.
admin_description: Add new users here. Users log in with username and password. The password is generated by the administrator (you) and shared with them. Users can change their username and password on their settings page. Only you can add or remove users.
admin_delete_user_confirm_description: This action cannot be undone. The user and all their data will be deleted.
admin_reset_database_confirm_description: All users, budgets, accounts, and transactions will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.
admin_generated_password_description: Send the generated password to the user
budget_users_dialog_title: Who has access to this budget?
budget_users_dialog_description: As the creator, you can invite other users to collaborate on this budget.
budget_users_invite_warning: When you accept an invitation, you get access to the {#b}entire{/b} budget plan including its accounts, categories, transactions, etc.
api_token_description: Connect the mobile app or other API clients to this instance. A token grants full access to your account — treat it like a password.
api_token_created_description: Scan the QR code with the app to connect, or copy the token. It is only shown this once.
api_token_qr_alt: QR code containing the server URL and the new API token
api_token_revoke_confirm_description: The token immediately loses access. Apps connected with it must be reconnected.
budget_settings_description: Here you can change the name and currency of your budget.
form_error_unexpected: Could not be saved. Please try again.
error_account_not_archivable: This account cannot be archived: its balance must be zero and all transactions must be validated.
error_account_not_deletable: This account cannot be deleted: no transaction may reference it.
error_account_archived: This account is archived. Restore it before adding transactions.
error_transfer_amount_positive: A transfer amount must be positive.
error_transfer_amount_zero: Enter an amount other than zero.
error_transfer_same_account: Source and destination account must differ.
error_transaction_is_transfer_leg: This transaction is part of a transfer. Edit the transfer instead.
error_category_not_archivable: This category cannot be archived: the remaining balance must be zero and all transactions must be validated.
error_category_not_deletable: This category cannot be deleted: the remaining balance must be zero and no transaction may reference it.
